sections.heading: ARCH College of Design & Business vs Ellen College of Design for Fashion Design - UG: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose ARCH College of Design & Business if you want a recorded fee of ₹3.8 lakh, in a private Fashion Design - UG setting at Jaipur.
We cannot yet recommend Ellen College of Design on fees or placements, because our live records do not carry a Fashion Design - UG programme row for it. Confirm the official site before you apply.

One important gap: our live records do not yet carry programme, fee or placement rows for Ellen College of Design on this Fashion Design - UG page, even though the comparison is published. Read the table with that gap in mind.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹3.8 lakh as a programme total for BA in Fashion Design at ARCH College of Design & Business.
Our records do not yet list a quotable recorded programme fee for Ellen College of Design on this course, so treat any figure on third-party sites as unverified until the official notice is checked.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for ARCH College of Design & Business here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
We do not have a 2020-or-later flagship placement record for Ellen College of Design on this page.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for ARCH College of Design & Business on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for Ellen College of Design on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Rajasthan. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: ARCH College of Design & Business is the better fit if its city, admission test and recorded Fashion Design - UG offering match what you want, and if you have confirmed the latest official notice.
Until Ellen College of Design has a recorded Fashion Design - UG programme and fee on this page, treat it as a lead to verify, not as a college you can rank from our table alone.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, ARCH College of Design & Business or Ellen College of Design?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. ARCH College of Design & Business and Ellen College of Design differ in more than one way: the useful differences are fees, the admission test and the kind of Fashion Design - UG classroom each campus offers.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for ARCH College of Design & Business vs Ellen College of Design?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹3.8 lakh for ARCH College of Design & Business on BA in Fashion Design; we do not hold a quotable fee for Ellen College of Design on this page. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for ARCH College of Design & Business and Ellen College of Design?
faqs.answer: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for ARCH College of Design & Business here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current. We do not have a 2020-or-later flagship placement record for Ellen College of Design on this page.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do ARCH College of Design & Business and Ellen College of Design accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list no listed exam on this page for ARCH College of Design & Business, and no listed exam on this page for Ellen College of Design. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are ARCH College of Design & Business and Ellen College of Design in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Jaipur, Rajasthan. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
